messages:
elaine (sales): Heads up — NHS POC (Novacare) just asked for compliance artifacts. They want ISO27001 scope, SOC 2 summary, and a signed pen-test letter by EOD Fri. Also asking if Dedicated vs Private changes pricing. Any blockers?

tara (solutions): On it. Need to confirm whether they require on-prem or VPC. For NHS orgs we usually recommend VPC + customer-managed KMS. @mike (security) can you list what we can share without an NDA?

mike (security): We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO scope statement, and our standard pen-test attestation letter. Uploaded template here: https://redwood-artifacts.s3/pen-test-letter-template.pdf. Note: we cannot share raw pen-test logs or vendor reports without NDA/legal review.

sam (eng): For the POC infra I recommend Dedicated (reserved) — gives predictable latency. Ballpark pricing depends on commit/throughput; quick thumb: ~£6k/mo for a minimal dedicated pool + telemetry. Will DM a more precise quote.

elaine (sales): They also asked about canary rollouts and fallback to smaller models on latency spikes — is that supported on Dedicated?

tara (solutions): Yes, rollouts + automatic fallback policies are supported. We'll need their SSO SAML metadata and IP ranges to provision. Also flagging that Legal will probably want an NDA before full SOC2 disclosure.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: POC environment provisioning queued — ETA 48h (job id: prov-2026-44).

mike (security): Action: I can produce redacted PDFs (SOC2 summary + ISO scope) and sign the pen-test letter once Legal clears. I can have the redacted artifacts and unsigned letter by today 15:00 UTC. Signed letter after Legal/NDAs, target Tue next week.

elaine (sales): Great — can we get the redacted ISO + SOC2 summary shared today? buyer is pushing timeline.

mike (security): Yes — will upload to secure link (S3 presigned) and post to #secure-share when ready. ETA 15:00 UTC. Reminder: redactions will remove customer-identifying info and internal IPs.

tara (solutions): Quick checklist for POC handoff: 1) NDA requested (elaine) 2) redacted SOC2 & ISO + pen-test template (mike) 3) pricing quote for Dedicated vs Private (sam) 4) staging creds + SSO metadata + IP allowlist (customer). Target: get artifacts to buyer before Fri EOD.

sam (eng): DMing detailed pricing now. Note: Private (on-prem) adds +30–50% ops/package fee and longer lead time.

elaine (sales): I'll push NDA with buyer and confirm whether they really need on-prem. Will update here once I hear back. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
